_run_003_summary: Third scheduled run completed 2026-05-17. Worked CR-002 (C1 sensitivity attack on criterion-fraction floor). Verdict label set OPEN → CONTESTED. Headline: the paper's categorical claim 'CF ∈ [0.60, 0.96] across all 4,410 (r,V,v,variant) combinations' is falsified by independent re-implementation. Replication finds CF range [0.30, 1.00]: variant A min CF=0.5587 at (r=10,V=0.55,v=1); variant B min CF=0.3040 at (r=10,V=0.25,v=4). 13.4% of swept rows below 0.60, 4.0% below 0.50. Reference-point validation: code matches paper at r=1.0 (0.728 vs 0.73) and r=3.2 (0.642 vs 0.64) to 0.002 of CF, confirming model implementation; disagrees at r=0.3 (mine 0.854, paper text 0.96 — but paper's own Figure 2 visually reads ~0.85, likely manuscript transcription error). Phase B extrapolation probes at V=1/N argmin: only pushing r>10 takes CF further down (asymptote ~0.26 at r=∞); all other axes push CF up — so categorical-floor failure is INTERIOR to the sweep, not an extrapolation artefact. Substantive spirit ('criterion typically dominates', median CF ≈ 0.76) survives; §5.1 theoretical argument unaffected. Verdict file proposes weaker reformulation preserving scientific point. Spawned CR-020 (C3 literature attack, overlaps CR-003), CR-021 (V=1/N degeneracy unified derivation), CR-022 (r=0.3 clarification note for owner). No new wiki stubs added. _run_005_summary: Fifth scheduled run completed 2026-05-17. Worked CR-026 (C3 re-derivation attack at V=0.75). Verdict label set WEAKLY-SUPPORTED → CONTESTED. Headline: §4.4 / §5.2 categorical 'VDA negligible (<0.005) at V≥0.75 regardless of r' is REFUTED internal to the model under its own assumptions (A1–A7). Sup VDA = 0.0410 coarse / 0.0400 refined at (r=0.10, v=5), V=0.75 — 8× the paper's 0.005 'negligible' threshold and 2× §4.4's own 0.02 'hot zone' boundary. Across the V=0.75 slice of the paper's primary 21×5 (r,v) grid, 8 cells violate <0.005 and 6 violate <0.02 — ~8% of the slice, not an isolated grid corner. Mechanism named in closed form: P_2 (value-blind, v=1 fixed-α) has a separate escape threshold r†(1) that is NOT arbitrarily small at high V; at V=0.75, N=4, r†(1)≈0.11 interior to paper's r-grid. The high-V VDA window (r†(v), r†(1)) at v=5, V=0.75 is approximately (0.025, 0.13), and the paper's grid samples two points inside it. Closed-form V_critical(r,N) ≈ 1/(1 + r(N-1)/κ) derived; empirical boundary V_critical(r=0.1, N=4) ∈ (0.775, 0.780); simple change-side approximation predicts 0.74 (4pp underestimate due to neglected FAR-side density terms — CR-027 spawned to fix). Counter-intuitive consequence: VDA grows with V inside the window before collapsing at V_critical; VDA at (V=0.75, r=0.1, v=5) is 2.6× larger than at (V=0.50, r=0.1, v=5), the paper's reference 'hot zone' point. Verdict CONTESTED (not REFUTED) because the substantive content of §4.4 / §5.2 (narrow window, criterion dominance per §5.1) survives — only the categorical wording fails. Proposed reformulation (derivation §7) with explicitly r-dependent V_critical threshold drafted; predicts Stănișor 2013 V1 reward signature as the neural correlate of the residual VDA window (reclassifying Stănișor from V0.1 'potential refutation' to V0.2 'predicted observation'). Verdict ledger after run-005: C1 CONTESTED, C2 CONFIRMED-UNDER-ATTACK, C3 CONTESTED, C4 OPEN, C5 OPEN; A1–A7 all OPEN. No new wiki stubs added (attack was internal to the model, not literature-driven). _run_006_summary: Sixth scheduled run completed 2026-05-18. Worked CR-004 with CR-019 as piggyback (per mission §3.5 / CR-019's prereq design). Verdict label set OPEN → WEAKLY-SUPPORTED for C4. Headline finding: the *empirical* C4 (no inversion across 4,410 primary-sweep rows at N=4) survives independent corroboration (direct query of CR-002 phase-A output: zero rows with α*_P1 < 0.25 or α*_P2 < 0.25). The paper's *theoretical justification* in §4.5 ('weighted reward loss exceeds gain regardless of r') is INCOMPLETE: derived the boundary one-sided derivative ∂E[R]/∂α|_{1/N⁻} = (2 d'_max f'(1/N) / (r+1)) · [A_0 − r·B_0/(N-1)] with A_0, B_0 r-independent. Closed-form inversion threshold r*_inv(V,v,N,CR) := (N-1)·A_0/B_0. Step A: 49.0% of 210 (V,v,variant) cells at N=4 have r*_inv ∈ [0.1, 10] — paper's swept r-range straddles the local-inversion threshold in half the cells, contradicting 'regardless of r' read locally. At corner (V=1/N=0.25, v=1): r*_inv = 1 exactly (proof in derivation §5: V·v = (1-V)/(N-1) = 1/N at this corner forces A_0 = B_0/(N-1) at symmetric criterion FOC). Step B: across the most-adversarial 13 cells at r=10, global α*∈[0.95,1.00]; left-branch local max exists at α≈0.02 but R_left < R_right by 0.005-0.150 reward units. Correct mechanism named: location-count asymmetry combined with value-weight inequality. At α→1 the single cued reaches d_max·f(1)=d_max; at α→0 the (N-1) uncued each reach only d_base + β[d_max·f(1/(N-1))-d_base] < d_max for N≥3. Combined with w_c ≥ w_u (equivalent to V ≥ 1/[(N-1)v+1], simplifying to V ≥ 1/N for v ≥ 1), this gives strict right-branch dominance globally. Step C: CR-019 resolved IN THE NEGATIVE — C4's V ≥ 1/N (weak) is correct, no V > 1/N strengthening needed; bimodality at V=1/N exactly is real (right-branch wins by ~0.005-0.014 reward units at r>1 due to location-count asymmetry; ties at r≤1). Anti-cue probe: at (V<1/N, v=1, N=2), inversion IS globally optimal — α* = 0.180 at r=1, dropping to α* = 0.020 at r=10. C4 fails outside the conditional V ≥ 1/N (or v sufficiently large), but the paper's primary sweep is inside the conditional. The verdict notes 4 spawned tasks: CR-031 (literature attack on C4 — second attack vector, medium), CR-032 (Anderson 2011 + Wang & Theeuwes 2018 + Geng 2014 stubs, low), CR-033 (β/γ kink sensitivity, low), CR-034 (anti-cue at N=4 derivation extension, low). 18 wiki entries consulted at full depth; 12 cited in verdict body; no new stubs added; 0 web fetches consumed (0 of soft cap 2). Verdict ledger after run-006: C1 CONTESTED, C2 CONFIRMED-UNDER-ATTACK, C3 CONTESTED, C4 WEAKLY-SUPPORTED, C5 OPEN; A1-A7 all OPEN. Four of five headline claims now attacked. Recommended next task: CR-031 (C4 literature attack — second vector for CONFIRMED-UNDER-ATTACK / CONTESTED elevation), or CR-005 (C5 replication — touches the only untouched headline claim).
_run_007_summary: Seventh scheduled run completed 2026-05-19. Worked CR-031 (C4 no-inversion literature attack — the second attack vector specified by the run-006 verdict). Verdict label WEAKLY-SUPPORTED -> CONFIRMED-CONDITIONAL. Headline: the distractor-suppression-learning literature is NOT a counterexample to C4. The single behavioural phenomenon resembling 'attending below uniform to a location' is statistical-learning suppression of a high-DISTRACTOR-probability (= low-TARGET-probability) location (Wang & Theeuwes 2018a, stubbed this run; Wang/Samara/Theeuwes 2019 eye-tracking: fewer saccades land there; Kong et al. 2020 biased-competition probe: suppress here => more attention at target). In the paper's model that location has target-validity < 1/N, i.e. ANTI-CUED, which is exactly where CR-004/run-006 showed in closed form the model itself predicts alpha* < 1/N. Convergence, not contradiction. Sub-question (i) (below-uniform allocation to a high-value VALIDLY-CUED location) resolves negative: value-driven capture pulls TOWARD value (Failing & Theeuwes 2018; Hickey 2010); Gupta & Sridharan 2024 is a failure-of-facilitation, not active inversion. Two clean mappings of suppression onto the model both leave C4 intact: (a) anti-cued cued-slot (model predicts inversion); (b) heterogeneous uncued allocation (outside the model's homogeneous-uncued scope -> a separate, unnamed assumption). Label is CONFIRMED-CONDITIONAL not CONFIRMED-UNDER-ATTACK because the claim provably FAILS outside V>=1/N. Kong 2020's reciprocity positively corroborates the paper's section 5.1 zero-sum reallocation framing. SURFACED a proposed new load-bearing assumption A8 (homogeneous uncued allocation, implicit in section 2.3 but absent from A1-A7) -> spawned CR-036 with proposed_mission_change:true (mission section 8.1). 1 stub added (audit exit 0; 240 papers, 5 abstract-depth); 2 PubMed calls (1 search + 1 metadata batch, at the soft cap of 2 fetches); 0 WebFetch/WebSearch. Verdict ledger after run-007: C1 CONTESTED, C2 CONFIRMED-UNDER-ATTACK, C3 CONTESTED, C4 CONFIRMED-CONDITIONAL, C5 OPEN; A1-A7 OPEN; A8 PROPOSED. Recommended next: CR-036 (substantive descendant) then CR-005 (only untouched headline claim, C5).

Headline: paper Appendix-A claim 'at r=1 the asymmetric model recovers the symmetric special case (beta=gamma=1); optimal alpha* and R* identical to machine precision, max diff 0.0 on 210 matched combos' is reproduced EXACTLY by an independent from-equations re-implementation -- d' arrays bit-identical (np.array_equal True), max|dalpha*|=max|dR*|=0.0 across all 210 (V x v x variant) combos at r=1, N=4, d'_max=2.0, f_0=0.5, sqrt. The run also EXPLAINS the exactness the paper only asserts: beta(1)=gamma(1)=1 are exact in IEEE-754, and every swept x=d'_max*f(.) in [1.0,2.0] lies inside the Sterbenz band [d'_base/2, 2*d'_base]=[0.75,3.0], so a+(x-a)=x bit-for-bit (Sterbenz lemma). Continuity probe: max|dR*| linear in |r-1| (slope ~0.084), exactly 0 at r=1 -- symmetric case is the smooth centre, not a knife-edge. No new wiki stub (attack internal to model); 0 web fetches. 4 wiki entries cited (reynolds_heeger2009, luo_maunsell2018, maunsell2015, sridharan2017) + 2 concept pages; empirical capture papers unrelated-on-inspection for this numerical claim. _run_009_summary: Ninth scheduled run completed 2026-05-22 (prompt v0.2). Worked CR-038 (C5 symmetric-recovery RE-DERIVATION) -- the designated second attack vector on C5, after run-008's replication. Verdict C5 WEAKLY-SUPPORTED -> CONFIRMED-UNDER-ATTACK (two distinct vectors across two runs, per mission s3.1/s6). Picked over CR-036 (A8) per the run-008 recommendation and mission s3.3 (highest-priority WEAKLY-SUPPORTED verdict) + s8.5 (honest small leap, no new compute). Headline: the paper's Appendix-A claim is now PROVEN, not just reproduced. Wrote Critique/derivations/C5--symmetric-recovery.md with two theorems + a scope clause: Theorem 1 -- beta(1)=2*1/(1+1)=1 and gamma(1)=2/(1+1)=1 are exact, so the asymmetric affine map d'_base + s*(x-d'_base) has unit slope at r=1 and collapses to x = d'_max f(.) (the symmetric 'single shared transfer function') as a real-number identity; the cancellation d'_base - d'_base = 0 is the entire content of the word 'reduces'. Theorem 2 (bit-exact 0.0) -- the asymmetric code path computes fl(a + fl(1.0*fl(x-a))); beta(1),gamma(1) are the exact float 1.0 (hex 0x1.0...p+0), multiply-by-1.0 is the IEEE-754 identity (checked on 1e7 random doubles), and Sterbenz's lemma (a/2<=x<=2a => fl(x-a)=x-a exactly) makes the round-trip return x bit-for-bit whenever the swept output is in the band [d'_base/2, 2 d'_base]. At the validation config (N=4, d'_max=2.0, f_0=0.5, sqrt): d'_base=1.5, band=[0.75,3.0], every swept x=2.0*f(.) in [1.0,2.0] subset [0.75,3.0], so '0.0' is a STRUCTURAL guarantee of the config, not luck -- the mechanism Appendix A asserts but never derives. Scope clause: Theorem 2's hypothesis is sufficient-not-necessary and fails when d'_max f_0 < d'_base/2, i.e. f_0 < h(1/N)/(1+h(1/N)) = 1/3 for sqrt,N=4; off-band the recovery is exact only to <=1 ulp. Independent sandbox verification (NOT reusing run-008's run.py) confirmed all three: beta(1)=gamma(1)=1.0 bit-exact; np.array_equal(asym_r1,sym)=True with max|delta|=0.0 over a 1e5-point alpha grid on both branches; and the off-band drift table reproduced run-008's notes to the digit (2.78e-17 / 5.55e-17 / 1.11e-16). Label is CONFIRMED-UNDER-ATTACK (not -CONDITIONAL) because the HEADLINE claim, scoped as the paper writes it to the 210 combos at the stated config, is proven exact; the conditional only governs generalisation to other (f_0,d'_max), which the paper never claimed. CR-039 (owner wording note) addressed inside this run -- its content is in the C5 v0.2 verdict Loose-end #1 with the exact threshold -- and re-homed as CR-041. No new wiki stub (attack internal to the model); 0 web fetches. s11 sweep re-run (anchors + {Sterbenz, floating-point, IEEE-754, machine precision, symmetric special case, beta+gamma}): the only papers/ 'floating-point' hit (beck2024_xlstm) is xLSTM overflow-stabilization, and the 'beta/gamma' hits (mongillo2008, buzsaki_wang2012) are oscillation bands -- all unrelated on inspection; genuine connections remain reynolds_heeger2009 (gain-modulation = beta half of r) and luo_maunsell2018 (SDT criterion/sensitivity substrate). No floating-point/numerical-methods literature exists in research_db/ (expected, acceptable gap). Spawned CR-040 (A3 beta*gamma=1 alternative-constraint re-derivation/replication OFF r=1 -- key observation: at r=1 both beta+gamma=2 and beta*gamma=1 give beta=gamma=1, so C5 is constraint-agnostic and the families AGREE at r=1, diverging only off r=1 where beta=sqrt(r), gamma=1/sqrt(r); the bridge from the now-closed C5 into the assumption layer, medium) and CR-041 (owner wording note, absorbs CR-039, low). Verdict ledger after run-009: C1 CONTESTED, C2 CONFIRMED-UNDER-ATTACK, C3 CONTESTED, C4 CONFIRMED-CONDITIONAL, C5 CONFIRMED-UNDER-ATTACK; A1-A7 OPEN, A8 ratified/untouched. ALL FIVE headline claims now settled-as-far-as-evidence-goes; the headline phase is complete and the assumption layer (A1-A8) is the sole remaining frontier. _run_010_summary: Tenth scheduled run completed 2026-05-23 (prompt v0.2). Worked CR-040 (A3 multiplicative-conservation re-derivation) -- the FIRST attack on the assumption layer, the bridge from the just-closed C5 into A1-A8. Verdict A3 (none) -> WEAKLY-SUPPORTED. Attacked the paper's own s5.5 robustness claim: 'the b+g=2 constraint conserves total attention magnitude; alternative constraints (e.g., multiplicative bg=1) could yield quantitatively different results, though the qualitative findings--non-monotonic VDA, no inversion, criterion dominance--should be robust.' Re-derivation (Critique/derivations/A3--multiplicative-conservation.md): solved both rules under the shared ratio b/g=r -> additive (2r/(r+1), 2/(r+1)) vs multiplicative (sqrt r, 1/sqrt r); PROVED the rescaling theorem (b,g)_mul = kappa(r)*(b,g)_add with kappa(r)=(r+1)/(2 sqrt r)=cosh(0.5 ln r)>=1 (verified 8.9e-16), so bg=1 does NOT conserve Sigma=b+g (=2kappa>=2) -- the paper's 'conserves total magnitude' is ADDITIVE-ONLY (citable correction); geometrically the bg=1 hyperbola sits on/above the b+g=2 line (AM-GM), tangent only at (1,1), so bg=1 is uniformly more aggressive. PROVED the two-limit theorem (VDA->0 at r->0,inf) holds under BOTH rules (b(0)=0, g(inf)=0 in both) => C2 non-monotonicity is constraint-robust. Focused slice (Critique/replications/A3--multiplicative-conservation/run.py, exit 0; reference regime N=4,d_max=2,f0=0.5,sqrt,V=0.5,v=5,A): all three s5.5-named findings SURVIVE the bg=1 swap -- (i) non-monotonic VDA robust, peak shifts 0.398->0.316 (deeper cost-dominant) and rises +14% (0.0797->0.0909; my additive 0.0797 matches paper Fig-4 ~0.080, validating the impl); (ii) no inversion robust within V>=1/N (min alpha*=1/N exactly across reference r-grid AND adversarial r=10 V>=1/N cells); (iii) criterion dominance survives but ERODES -- R(P3),R(P4) are family-independent (both at alpha=1/N, weights x zero bracket), only R(P1) moves; CF floor 0.601->0.507, only 0.007 above 0.5 at r=10. Free C5 cross-check: at r=1 both families return identical numbers (VDA 0.03983, CF 0.7282, a_P1 1.000, a_P2 0.750) -- the constraint-agnosticism proved in the C5 v0.2 verdict. Label WEAKLY-SUPPORTED (first vector, mission s6 -- cannot elevate on one run); not CONTESTED (nothing flipped) but FLAGGED RISK: C1 already CONTESTED under additive (run-003: CF->0.304 in low-V/high-v/variant-B cells outside this slice), and bg=1 lowers CF wherever R(P1) grows, so those cells may push CF<0.5 => criterion dominance could BREAK there -- the one place A3 -> CONTESTED. s11 sweep: reynolds_heeger2009 (divisive=multiplicative normalization is the canonical neural mechanism => bg=1 is the MORE biologically apt conservation rule; substrate for s5.4's gain(b)-vs-suppression(g) reading of r) is the standout cite; also maunsell2015, luo_maunsell2018 (SDT substrate behind CF erosion), reynolds1999 / desimone_duncan1995 (biased-competition zero-sum = additive analog), concept coalition_resource_competition (the user's finite-resource framing). dopamine/RPE/basal-ganglia/LIP/FEF/saccade s11.1 anchors all unrelated on inspection (value-SOURCE, not conservation-FORM). PRISM implication: PRISM's FiLM is multiplicative-gain (closer to bg=1), so PRISM agents should show slightly MORE value-reallocation / slightly LESS pure-criterion routing than the additive normative figures -- checkable vs Prism/figures/avg_alpha_*.pdf. No new wiki stub (attack internal to model + a review-depth mechanism cite); 0 web fetches. Spawned CR-042 (sensitivity: peak-shift across f0/h, low), CR-043 (literature: firsthand additive-vs-divisive primate cite, low); PROMOTED CR-008 medium->high and re-scoped as the designated A3 second vector (multiplicative sweep over the additive-CF<0.60 cells). Verdict ledger after run-010: C1 CONTESTED, C2 CUA, C3 CONTESTED, C4 CONFIRMED-CONDITIONAL, C5 CUA; A3 WEAKLY-SUPPORTED (first assumption-layer verdict), A1/A2/A4/A5/A6/A7 OPEN, A8 ratified/untouched. _run_011_summary: Eleventh scheduled run completed 2026-05-24 (prompt v0.2). Worked CR-008 (A3 SECOND attack vector, replication) -- the designated decider after the run-010 CR-040 re-derivation left A3 WEAKLY-SUPPORTED with one flagged risk. Verdict A3 WEAKLY-SUPPORTED -> CONTESTED. Picked per mission s3.3 (A3 was the only WEAKLY-SUPPORTED verdict; prereq CR-005 done) and the explicit run-010 recommendation. Attacked the criterion-dominance conjunct of the paper's s5.5 robustness claim ('the b+g=2 vs bg=1 constraint choice leaves non-monotonic VDA, no inversion, criterion dominance robust'). The open question CR-040 left: does the bg=1 CF erosion (reference-slice floor 0.601->0.507) push CF strictly <0.5 in the low-V/high-v/variant-B corner where C1 is ALREADY CONTESTED under additive (run-003 min CF 0.304)? (b) CUED-ABSORPTION PRE-EMPTION: the two concentration pressures (accelerating h; benefit-dominant kink r>1) are subsets of winner-take-all, and by the value-weight inequality w_c>=w_u (C4 Eq.6.4, holds under V>=1/N,v>=1) + the location-count asymmetry (only the cued slot reaches d'_max) the cued wins the budget FIRST => alpha*->1, B=1-alpha*->0 -- FASTEST exactly for the accelerating a^2 that most wanted to concentrate (perfect anti-correlation). Decisive from-scratch joint optimum over (alpha, uncued-winner-share) on Da=0.005: max|DR_uncon-homog| = 1.4e-4 over ALL four h and ALL swept regimes (a coarse-grid snap, negative), and =0 EXACTLY for a^2 (alpha*=1, B=0). _run_015_summary: Fifteenth scheduled run completed 2026-05-24 (prompt v0.2). Attacked the A2xA8 INTERACTION: CR-045/run-013 proved A8 (homogeneous-uncued allocation) is the OPTIMUM, but its exchange-symmetry argument requires a SINGLE GLOBAL r; under a per-location ratio vector r_i (the R2 heterogeneity established empirically in v0.1) does the optimal allocation deviate enough to shift a headline number? Deliverables: Critique/derivations/A2xA8--heterogeneous-r-allocation.md + Critique/replications/A2xA8--heterogeneous-r/ (verify_heterogeneous_r.py, verify_deviation_interior.py, output/*; results.json sha256 2659d7b5..., byte-identical on re-run). FINDING: the A2xA8 interaction is real but BOUNDED -- NO headline claim shifted by R2 heterogeneity, on three legs. (a) CRITICALITY BREAKS: distinct r_i => distinct transfer functions => E[R] no longer symmetric in the uncued allocations, so the S_{N-1} argument fails and equal-split is GENERICALLY NOT a critical point -- closed-form tangent gradient g_i = M_i*gamma_i*rho depends on slot i only through r_i (Eq.1.2), zero iff all r_i equal; verified ||g-mean||=0.072 at +-30% spread vs exactly 0 at homogeneity; the optimum tilts budget TOWARD the more cost-dominant (smaller-r_i) slots. (b) BUT the deviation is SECOND-ORDER in var(r_i) and tiny: the restricted Hessian stays neg-def on the smooth gamma-branch by the SAME log-concavity-of-Phi argument as CR-045 s2.2 applied PER SLOT (the no-FA spreading force lambda_noFA,i<=0 is r-INDEPENDENT in sign), so the optimal tilt is O(spread) and its reward O(var r_i): max DR=1.50e-4 over all interior (value-blind, non-absorbed) cells at +-30% = the CR-045 homogeneous-case grid slack itself. (c) CUED-ABSORPTION PRE-EMPTION is STRUCTURALLY r-INDEPENDENT (C4 s6: w_c>=w_u from validity/value + the location-count asymmetry that only the cued reaches d'_max -- no r in either) => alpha*->1, B->0 at every value-contrast cell (DR=0 EXACTLY at the C2 headline cell V=0.5,v=5 even at cost-dominant r_cued=0.4), and the cost-dominant P3 kink (alpha=1/N) keeps equal-split optimal under heterogeneity (DR=0 across all spreads => the CRITERION FRACTION is UNTOUCHED by the A8-relaxation). LEVEL EFFECT (A8 imposed, the run-014 reframing question): C2's non-monotonic VDA peak essentially fixed (0.0771->0.0770, r_peak=0.398 under +-30%; k=1.5/3 spreads keep it 0.0765-0.0798 @ r_cued~0.36) => C2 REFRAMES cleanly as a statement about the CUED ratio r_cued (run-014 conjecture CONFIRMED, not refuted); C4 robust (its CR-004 proof is r-independent geometry); C1's already-contested corner (r=10,V=0.25,v=4,B) NOT deepened (CF 0.3040->0.3055). _run_016_summary: Sixteenth scheduled run completed 2026-05-24 (prompt v0.2). Worked CR-006 (A1 per-location SDT independence, LITERATURE attack) -- the paper's FIRST-NAMED s5.5 limitation and the run-015-recommended pick (richest wiki coverage via cohen_maunsell2009; the assumption the CR-048 per-slot gradient presumed). Paper framing: s2.1 'the observer makes INDEPENDENT detection decisions at each location using SDT' (Eqs.1-2); Eq.(9) P_no-fa=(1-FAR_c)(1-FAR_u)^(N-1) is the joint no-FA prob as a PRODUCT of marginals; s5.5 names A1 and asserts the numbers are 'an upper bound on VDA benefit'. PIVOTAL MOVE (mirrors A2 R1/R2 split): separated I-dec (the Eq.9 product needs decision-level FA independence -- load-bearing for C1's criterion fraction) from I-neur (per-location d' as a marginal vs cortex's d'^2 prop (dmu)^T Sigma^-1 (dmu)). FINDINGS: (1) premise EMPIRICALLY FALSE under I-neur and in the paper's OWN paradigm class -- cohen_maunsell2009 (macaque orientation change-detection w/ peripheral validity cue) finds r_SC~=0.20 and that >80% of attention's behavioural benefit comes from correlation REDUCTION, <20% from single-neuron rate gain; ruff_cohen2016 (within-area down / between-area up SIGN reversal) + srinath2021 (~2/3 of the cross-population gain is supra-pairwise shared-variance amplification) show the omitted object is a structured, attention-modulated Sigma, not a scalar. (2) Independence is LOAD-BEARING for C1: it is exactly the Eq.9 product. Closed form via SLEPIAN's inequality -- equicorrelated-Gaussian no-change-trial decision variables give P_no-fa=Phi_N(c;R_rho) >= Prod(1-FAR_i) for rho>0, monotone, so the INDEPENDENT product is the FA-penalty-MAXIMISING corner; positive correlations relax the multiple-comparisons pressure that sets the optimal criteria, so the criterion fraction is computed at a boundary in correlation space. (3) The two-tool taxonomy (criterion shift vs d'-reallocation) OMITS the empirically DOMINANT lever (decorrelation), which the scalar d'(alpha) conflates with marginal gain (mcadams1999: real, multiplicative, Fano-flat -- the d' tool IS genuine) -- so 'criterion captures 60-96%' is a WITHIN-MODEL reward decomposition, not a claim about cortex's mechanism inventory. FAIR LEGS: A1 is the FIELD-STANDARD behavioural idealisation of cued detection (hawkins1990 + the SDT-of-attention tradition), and ernst_banks2002 s6 supplies the optimal-pooling theorem (correlated noise breaks the simple independent rule), tying s5.5's 'single global response' concern to A6 (CR-011). (4) The s5.5 'UPPER BOUND on VDA' self-characterisation is UNDERIVED and SIGN-AMBIGUOUS: neural-decorrelation reading -> value-directed decorrelation could make real VDA EXCEED the model's ('upper bound' WRONG); decision-aggregation reading -> fewer global-criterion DoF could raise VDA reliance (against) OR positive rho relaxing the FA penalty could make criterion more effective (supporting). Literature cannot adjudicate the sign -> a re-derivation must. Label WEAKLY-SUPPORTED (mission s6: one vector cannot elevate; NOT CONTESTED because no attack SHIFTED a headline number this run -- premise shown false but not yet consequential, the same shape as A2/run-014's first touch).
